reviews.text: No10 Boston - I was a little worried about this shade as I thought it might be a little too opaque/bold for my pale muted skin tone but I was surprised by how much I love this shade! It’s super wearable and gives a hint of colour that can be built up and just brings a bit of life to my face! It’s a gorgeous cool toned ruddy red colour. Very moisturising and very glowy/juicy on the lips! I will definitely be repurchasing this shade again and it’s my 2nd time purchasing the original clear shade too - LOVE this lip gloss!
reviews.zh: No10 Boston——我本來有少少擔心呢個色號，以為對我呢個蒼白、色調偏淡嘅膚色嚟講，可能會太深、太搶眼，但係我好鍾意呢個色號，真係令我好驚喜！佢好百搭，帶少少顏色，可以慢慢疊深，亦都令我面上有少少生氣！佢係一個好靚嘅冷調磚紅色。非常滋潤，唇部好有光澤、好水潤！我一定會再買呢個色號，而且呢個係我第二次買原本嘅透明色——好鍾意呢款唇彩！

reviews.text: Lovely hydrating lipgloss. Is a little bit sticky and hair will stick to it if there’s a breeze but it’s very hydrating and doesn’t dry out my lips at all. Has a beautiful glass like shine! Unfortunately the cap broke on this when I tried to pull the lid off when the applicator was twisted to the lock position. The cap became stuck and wouldn’t come loose and then trying to get it off the whole applicator came off and won’t reattach unfortunately. I will be repurchasing though as the gloss is so good haha! Also the cushioning on the applicator is very comfortable on the lips and nice to use
reviews.zh: 好靚嘅保濕唇釉。有少少黏，如果有風吹，頭髮會黏喺上面，但佢好保濕，完全唔會令我嘅唇乾。有好漂亮嘅玻璃光澤！可惜嘅係，我嘗試撳開蓋嗰陣，塗抹頭扭咗去鎖定位，之後蓋子卡住，點都拆唔開，然後成個塗抹頭都整走咗，再都裝唔返上去。不過我會再買，因為唇釉真係好好，哈哈！另外，塗抹頭嘅軟墊用嚟搽唇都好舒服，好好用。

reviews.text:
Yippee! I wanted this lippie so badly that I felt like I waited a month to receive it, but no it was just 2 weeks lol! anywaysss, I bought the shade 05 AMALFI, and oh my god I cannot stop using it ever since. It's moisturizing, not sticky, light-weight, and beautifully pigmented. If you're looking for a lippie that's best for natural makeup looks, or something to wear on the go, this one's perfect! I'm a warm tone, and this shade fits me super well, my skin instantly warms instead of looking like a sick, pale Victorian child lmao. BUT SERIOUSLY, GO GET THIS, I LOVE IT SOOO MUCH, IM GONNA GET OTHER SHADES TOO LOLOL 😼💗 

LIP COMBO TIP: TRY IT WITH A BROWN LIP LINER, THANK ME LATER :) <3
reviews.zh:
耶！我好想要呢支唇膏，等咗好似一個月咁長，但其實只係兩個星期 lol！總之，我買咗 05 AMALFI，我自從買咗之後就停唔到用。佢保濕、唔黏、質地輕，上色都好靚。如果你想搵一支適合自然妝或者外出用嘅唇膏，呢支就最啱！我係暖色調，呢個色好啱我，我嘅皮膚即刻變得暖咗，唔會似一個病病哋、蒼白嘅維多利亞時代小孩 lmao。但係真係要講，快啲去買，我好鍾意，我會再買其他色！LOLOL 😼💗

唇部配搭小貼士：試吓配啡色唇線筆，之後記得多謝我 :) <3

reviews.text: Like all of unleashias products this one was incredible. its a perfect netural MLBB shade for every skintone, so ofc its brown girl approved!! I'm shocked more people arent talking about it. the applicator and packaging is absolutely brilliant, and having a lock system on the product is always appreciated, the silicone applicator feels very luxurious to the touch. It's truly a gloss with a balm texture, not even remotely sticky and it fills tiny lip wrinkles! I'M IN LOVE!!!
reviews.zh: 好似 Unleashia 所有產品一樣，呢款都好正。係一款完美嘅中性 MLBB 色，啱所有膚色，所以當然係棕膚女生認證嘅！！我好驚訝點解冇多啲人討論。塗抹頭同包裝都非常出色，產品有鎖定裝置，一直都令人欣賞，矽膠塗抹頭摸落好有質感。佢真係係一款帶有潤唇膏質地嘅唇釉，完全唔黏，仲可以填補細細嘅唇紋！我好愛！！！

reviews.text: This lip treatment is a winner for anyone craving moisture. It glides on smoothly, delivering a deeply hydrating feel that lasts for hours, so you're not constantly reapplying. While the scent isn't my favorite, it's subtle enough to overlook, especially when you consider the stunning Amalfi color. This shade is truly beautiful and surprisingly long-lasting, giving your lips a lovely tint. And let's not forget the donut applicator, it's not just adorable, it's also incredibly practical and makes application a breeze!
reviews.zh: 呢款唇部護理產品適合所有想要補充水分嘅人。佢搽落好順滑，保濕感覺可以持續好幾個鐘，所以唔使一直補搽。雖然我唔係好鍾意佢嘅香味，但係都唔算明顯，尤其係當你考慮到好靚嘅 Amalfi 色之後。呢個色真係好靚，持久度出奇地好，為你嘅唇添上一層好漂亮嘅色調。仲有，唔好忘記甜甜圈形狀嘅塗抹頭，佢唔單止好可愛，仲非常實用，令搽唇變得好輕鬆！

reviews.text: Okay so I’m obsessed with lip balms and I like gloss so this is The Product. I like the applicator. The colour in my photo pinker than it normally would because I didn’t put that much on so my natural lip colour is mostly showing. I just wanted to try it a bit before actually going out and using it. It actually looks so gorgeous if u put more on. I wore it out to eat and shockingly it stayed on way better than any other balm/gloss ????? (I was eating fried chicken as well lmao?) oh yeah I got the shade amalfi
reviews.zh: 好啦，我好迷唇膏，又鍾意唇釉，所以呢款就係我嘅最愛產品。我鍾意個塗抹頭。我相入面嘅顏色比平時粉紅啲，因為我冇搽太多，所以我嘅天然唇色大部分都睇得到。我只係想試吓，然後先出去用。如果你搽多啲，效果其實好靚。我落咗街食嘢，點知好似好持久，比任何其他潤唇膏／唇釉都好好多 ????? （我嗰陣仲食緊炸雞 lmao?） 哦，仲有，我買咗 amalfi 呢個色。

reviews.text: I got the color no.4 Bora Bora as it seemed to be the most cool toned out of the offered ones and I have to say it does pull a bit warmer on me in person. Nonetheless it looks really nice and and I would describe it as a warmer tone for people with a cool undertone. It has a little squishy ring/applicator that I wasn't too sure of at first but it actually is really nice to apply the product quickly and evenly. It also left my lips feeling nice and moisturized without feeling heavy or sticky and has such a pretty glossy look. It is a bit thicker than the lip oil I like to use when I am on the go, but I will definitely add it to my purse to carry around with me to do quick touch-ups or to just bring some natural color to my lips! Overall, great product to have in your bag!
reviews.zh: 我買咗 4 號 Bora Bora，因為喺提供嘅色號入面，佢睇落係最冷色調嗰款，但係我真人試色，佢喺我身上偏暖少少。不過佢都好靚，我會形容係適合冷調膚色人士嘅暖色調。佢有個軟軟嘅圈狀塗抹器，一開始我唔太肯定，但係其實用嚟快速、均勻咁搽產品都好好用。搽完之後唇部感覺好水潤，唔會覺得厚重或者黏，而且光澤感都好靚。佢比我平時外出用嘅唇油厚身啲，但係我一定會放入手袋入面，用嚟快速補妝，或者為唇色添上少少自然色彩！總括嚟講，係一件好好用嘅產品，放喺袋入面好啱。

reviews.text: I tried this gloss balm for the first time and I think it will definitely remain in my routine, I'm in love!! The texture is very soft and plump, not sticky. It is very hydrating thanks to the vitamin and peptides, it's so good for my dry skin. Even if it is a gloss balm it is very pigmented and can be used alone or in combo with a tint. The Amalfi color is very beautiful and I think I will try others. The "donut" applicator makes it very easy to apply. Highly recommended!!
reviews.zh: 我第一次試呢款潤唇釉，我覺得佢一定會留喺我嘅日常護理度，我好愛佢！！質地好軟、飽滿，唔會黏。因為有維他命同胜肽，所以保濕效果好好，對我嘅乾性皮膚嚟講好好。雖然佢係潤唇釉，但上色都好靚，可以單獨用，或者配搭唇彩一齊用。Amalfi 色好靚，我諗我會試埋其他色。「甜甜圈」塗抹頭令搽唇好容易。非常推薦！！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
